import random, string, re, importlib.util, sys
from pathlib import Path

# Load updated module
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', '/work/textmask.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# Original behavior snapshot
def old_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

# Targeted checks
assert mod.name_tokens('foo-bar-foo') == sorted({'foo-bar-foo','foo','bar'}, key=len, reverse=True)
assert mod.masked('Foo foo bar foo-bar-foo baz', 'foo-bar-foo') == old_masked('Foo foo bar foo-bar-foo baz', 'foo-bar-foo')
assert mod.masked('AB ab a-b', 'AB-a') == old_masked('AB ab a-b', 'AB-a')

# Randomized equivalence checks
alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '- _.'
for i in range(500):
    name_parts = []
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,4)):
        part = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters) for __ in range(random.randint(1,8)))
        name_parts.append(part)
    name = '-'.join(name_parts)
    text = ''.join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(random.randint(0,120)))
    a = mod.masked(text, name)
    b = old_masked(text, name)
